name: Bullet hit (ground)
description: A bullet kicks up a spray of soil, pebbles and dust from the ground that falls back quickly.

looks.text: A close-up texture swatch of a burst of pale grey dust and chips: colour and detail only. It is not an object to place in the shot.

prompt.subject: a bullet impact in {where}
prompt.timing: a bullet kicks up dust and chips from {where} at {impact}, settling by {settle} and gone by {clear}
prompt.action: At {impact} a bullet strikes {where}: a sharp burst of dust and small chips kicks up at full real-time speed with no slow motion and settles within half a second.
prompt.sound: a sharp bullet impact on the ground
